Run 1 and 2's fixes hold: 232 of 233 of their specs pass.

findings.title: Insights: choosing Goals or Year (or swiping there) slides the whole screen sideways, cutting off the left edge of every card and the tab bar
findings.detail: `StepPager` calls `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' })` on the chosen step name (`apps/web/src/blocks/steps.tsx:90`). `scrollIntoView` scrolls every scrollable ancestor, and the app shell (`div.safe-top`, `overflow: hidden`, `scrollWidth` 1917) is one, so it moves sideways until the name is centred in the shell too. The first two steps need no shift; the later ones do. The shift is not reset until you leave Insights. It is the screen the owner marked with a star.
findings.repro: /insights in any look -> tap Goals, then Year (or swipe to them). In the console: document.querySelector('div.safe-top').scrollLeft. Spec: qa/e2e/b04r-r3-flowsA.spec.ts 'R3-FLOW-4b', b04r-r3-evidence.spec.ts 'R3-EV-3'

findings.title: Sen's memory: a double tap on Forget forgets two notes, and Undo brings back only one
findings.detail: `memory.tsx` calls `write({ type: 'memory.forget' })` straight from `onClick`, with no tap guard. The list closes up under the finger, so a second tap forgets the next note; one toast replaces the other, so Undo restores only the last. The first note is gone for good. patterns §7 says every destructive or list-changing action uses `settled()`; txn Delete, Skipped and Review do, Forget does not.
findings.repro: /s/agent/memory -> tap the first Forget twice, 150 ms apart on the same pixel -> Undo. Spec: b04r-r3-flowsB.spec.ts 'R3-FLOW-X1', b04r-r3-evidence.spec.ts 'R3-EV-4'
findings.evidence:
R3-EV-4: 4 notes, 2 after a double tap, 3 after Undo
toasts after the double tap: [ 'Forgotten\nUndo' ] (one)
findings.spec: R3-AC-24, patterns §7 Toasts and undo (one change per double tap)

findings.title: Three behaviours the contract cares about can be broken with every test staying green
findings.detail: Probed by one-line breaks against the project's own suites (apps/web, minted, 239 tests on a dev server; the red ones in every run are the production-only and slow-look tests that cannot pass on a dev server, 8 of them, also red with no break). (a) The tab bar hides on task screens (P §6): `showsTabBar` returning true for everything, and `manual`, `payday`, `confirm`, `balance-check` marked `pushed`, turned only `frame.spec`'s /scan check red (the first) and nothing (the second). (b) Predictions are words, not facts: Insights' takeaway `An estimate for payday:` changed to `Left at payday:`, and Usage's `Estimated cost` / `About RM` / `The cost is an estimate…` changed to `Cost` / `RM` / `The cost.`: no test noticed. Only the cycle sheet's `An estimate` is asserted. (c) Money in carries a `+` (P §3, colour is never the only signal): `const plus = false` in `Money` turned nothing red (one unrelated timing flake in blocks.spec 'right after Undo' appeared once under load; it passes 3 of 3 with the break when the machine is quiet).
findings.repro: see the Probes table; scripts in qa/e2e/b04r3-proj.config.ts
findings.evidence:
(a) 53 passed, 1 failed: frame.spec.ts:174 'the frame clears the status bar and, with no tab bar...' (the /scan assertion). With manual/payday/confirm/balance-check set to 'pushed': 231 passed, 8 failed, all in edges.spec/production.spec (the same 8 as on clean source)
(b) and (c): 231 passed, 8 failed (the same 8)
grep '+RM' apps/web/e2e: no assertion
findings.spec: R3-AC-57, CLAUDE.md "a prediction never shares a table with a fact", patterns §3, §6

findings.title: Text at 1.5x on a 360 px phone: Budgets runs off the screen, Settings cuts its amount, and the app bar title becomes "B…"
findings.detail: patterns §8 says text scales to at least 1.5x without clipping and amounts wrap before they truncate. At 390 px the project's own check passes; at 360 px (a common Android width) Budgets' `RM0.00 of RM150.00` ends at x=399 of 360, the Settings Sen row's `~RM3.80 this month` and Settings > Sen's `About RM3.80` are cut by an ellipsis, the Appearance row's title and state overlap, and with *Add a budget* in the bar the title is `B…`. The project check runs at 390 only.
findings.repro: set localStorage 'sen.dev.textScale' = '1.5', viewport 360x740: /s/budgets and /s/settings. Spec: b04r-r3-evidence.spec.ts 'R3-EV-2'; survey b04r-r3-survey.spec.ts

findings.title: Balance check and first-run's accounts step don't validate when you leave a field
findings.detail: Both screens reset a field's error to the empty string on every keystroke (`setErrors(... : '')`); `MoneyInput` shows `error ?? blurError`, and `''` is not nullish, so the blur message never shows. Add expense passes `undefined` and works. patterns §7: validate on blur and on submit.

findings.title: Delete (and the app bar's Back) call history.back() with nothing to go back to when a payment is opened from a link
findings.detail: `txn.tsx` Delete ends with `router.history.back()` and `AppBar` Back is `router.history.back()`; Add expense and Balance check check `router.history.canGoBack()` first. A payment opened from a notification or widget has no earlier in-app screen. In a browser tab the page after Delete is the previous document (here `about:blank`); I could not try the Android shell.
findings.repro: open /s/txn?id=<a payment> directly -> ⋯ -> Delete. Spec: b04r-r3-evidence.spec.ts 'R3-EV-5' (the harness adds an about:blank entry, so history.length is 2)
findings.evidence: R3-EV-5: history.length 2; after Delete the page is about:blank
findings.spec: R3-AC-56, screens.md "Back always returns to where you came from"

findings.title: D129 and patterns §7 disagree on small labels over cards
findings.detail: D129: a heading is always bigger than what it heads. §7's `GroupCard` takes a label above it in secondary text (13 px), and Review's kinds (*Categories · 2*), Accounts' *Elsewhere* and Subscriptions' *Declared* are 13 px over 15 px rows. The code follows §7. The owner should say which wins.

findings.title: Four screens carry a 3 to 4 line paragraph where the brief allows one line
findings.detail: At 390 px: Balance check's intro (3 lines), Capture > Your apps' and Keep Sen running's closing paragraphs (4 lines each), Captured on this phone (3 lines, allowed by §7's raw-notification rule). They are footnotes rather than how-tos.
